grammarFocus: we / they；are；规则复数；my / your / his / her；have / has。
title: My Family Photo
instructions: 这是模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。听一段对话，完成8个问题。每题只有一个正确答案。填空题答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过字数限制。
transcript:
A: Look at this photo. This is my family. We are in the living room.
B: Nice. Who is that woman?
A: That is my aunt. She has two children.
B: And who are they?
A: They are my cousins. They are ten and twelve.
B: Are your parents in the photo?
A: Yes. My father is here. My mother is there. They have three children: my brother, my sister, and me.
B: So there are six people in your family?
A: Yes, six: my parents, my brother, my sister, and me. My grandparents are not in this photo. They are in the kitchen.

questions.prompt: 照片中说话人一家在哪里？
questions.explanation: A说“We are in the living room.”，所以他们在客厅。
questions.evidence: We are in the living room.

questions.explanation: B问“Who is that woman?”，A回答“That is my aunt.”，所以那个女人是A的阿姨。
A说“She has two children.”，所以阿姨有两个孩子。

questions.prompt: A的表兄弟姐妹年龄分别是多少？用数字填空：____ and ____。
questions.explanation: A说“They are ten and twelve.”，所以表兄弟姐妹的年龄是十岁和十二岁。
A说“They have three children: my brother, my sister, and me.”，所以父母有三个孩子。
questions.evidence: They have three children: my brother, my sister, and me.

questions.explanation: B问“So there are six people in your family?”，A回答“Yes, six: my parents, my brother, my sister, and me.”，所以一共六口人。
questions.evidence: Yes, six: my parents, my brother, my sister, and me.

questions.explanation: A说“My grandparents are not in this photo. They are in the kitchen.”，所以祖父母在厨房。
A说“Yes, six: my parents, my brother, my sister, and me.”，所以照片里有六个人。
questions.evidence: Yes, six: my parents, my brother, my sister, and me.

grammar.title: we / they + are; 规则复数; my / your / his / her; have / has
grammar.explanation: 我们用“we are”表示“我们是”，用“they are”表示“他们是”。名词变复数一般加-s，如parents, cousins。my表示“我的”，your表示“你的”，his表示“他的”，her表示“她的”。have用于I/you/we/they，has用于he/she/it。
grammar.example: They have three children: my brother, my sister, and me.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：We ____ in the living room.
questions.evidence: We are in the living room.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的单词填空：She ____ two children.
选择正确的单词填空：They ____ my cousins.
选择正确的单词填空：My father is here. ____ mother is there.
questions.explanation: 说话人介绍自己的父亲和母亲，这里指“我的母亲”，所以用My。
questions.evidence: My father is here. My mother is there.
